mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the protective surface to the deeper skin was worthwhile because it brought the layers together and showed where the gland and nerve endings belong.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the nerve endings was straightforward once the named slot appeared, so it felt more like finishing a checklist than figuring something out.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the outer layer has no blood vessels, yet its living cells get supplies from the tissue underneath.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary: the pictures and named slots made the pairings understandable.

continue.text: I would choose to continue because connecting the skin to the body showed how protection, sweat and nerves fit together, and I would be curious to see what comes next.
